verdict.rationale: Retell documents latency tuning guidance for transcription mode: you can optimize for speed using interim results with low endpointing, or for accuracy with higher endpointing. Its analytics dashboard and AI QA also measure latency. However, the pack contains no published end-to-end voice latency numbers or benchmarks backing speed claims, and the tuning guidance covers only the transcription stage. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end latency figures or benchmarks, tuning guidance beyond transcription (LLM, TTS, network/telephony), independent latency corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims

citations.quote: optimize for speed: uses the latest interim results with a low endpointing setting... optimize for accuracy: uses the results with a higher endpointing setting
Real time transcription is often a trade off between latency and accuracy.
Build custom Retell analytics dashboards to track call and chat metrics like success rate, latency, cost, and concurrency
